label: prose:intro-hecke-chi-closed-forms
html: The Iwahori–Hecke algebra H_n(q) carries two complementary coordinate charts: the Markov u-coordinate adapted to recursive braid-word reduction, and the Wedderburn character coordinate \chi^\lambda indexed by partitions \lambda \vdash n. This section derives the explicit change of basis between the u-coordinate discharge rules and the irreducible Hecke characters \chi^\lambda, and initiates the closed-form evaluation of \chi^\lambda beginning with the totally symmetric three-strand representation V_{(3)}.
